metadata.title: सैलाना आदिवासी बाज़ार | Main Bh Bharat Live
metadata.description:
We are coming to you LIVE from the vibrant weekly market of Sailana, a tribal-dominated region in Madhya Pradesh. Every Sunday, Bhil Adivasis from remote villages gather here to sell roosters, goats, and other livestock to earn essential income.
This week’s market is especially crucial. It’s monsoon season, and the tribals urgently need money for seeds, fertilizers, and pesticides to begin cultivation. With rising input costs and uncertain rainfall, their struggles are real and immediate.
Join our team on the ground as we speak to the sellers, hear their concerns, and bring you stories of survival, tradition, and resilience.
👉 Don’t miss this powerful glimpse into the tribal economy at a grassroots level.📍 Sailana, Ratlam district, Madhya Pradesh
